summary: Replaced the global settings with an immutable Settings value, make(), and an explicit conf parameter through all code paths, with the specified entry-point signatures; import-time and stale caches (units, dim divisor, freight minimum, tax default, fx factors, zone table, fuel factor, delivery holidays) now depend on conf. Tests were migrated and extended (67 pass), and 700 randomized CLI runs matched the original byte-for-byte.
